# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues, pull requests, or discussions. Use this repository's GitHub private vulnerability reporting feature:

**[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/liulixin-lex/xy2api/security/advisories/new)**

## 漏洞报告

请不要通过公开的 GitHub Issue、Pull Request 或 Discussion 报告安全漏洞。请使用本仓库的 GitHub 私密漏洞报告功能：

**[提交漏洞报告](https://github.com/liulixin-lex/xy2api/security/advisories/new)**
